meta.name: algorithmic-art
meta.description: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration. Use this when users request creating art using code, generative art, algorithmic art, flow fields, or particle systems. Create original algorithmic art rather than copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用代码生成视觉艺术作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想用代码创作独特的视觉艺术
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create unique visual art with code

howto.what: 它会先写一份「算法美学宣言」的 .md 文件,再用 p5.js 生成带随机种子的生成艺术,打包成一个能在浏览器直接打开、可调参数重绘的 HTML 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求用代码创作艺术,或提到生成艺术、流场、粒子系统等时触发。原文要求做原创作品,不复制已有艺术家的作品,以避免版权问题。

say.text: 用 p5.js 做一个粒子流场的生成艺术作品
say.note: 先写美学宣言,再产出可交互 HTML

say.text: 帮我做一份「量子谐波」主题的算法艺术,种子用 42
say.note: 同一种子每次输出相同结果

say.text: 把刚那件作品的粒子数量调多些,重新生成一版
say.note: 侧栏参数和种子可改后重绘

howto.what_en: It first writes an algorithmic-art philosophy as a .md file, then builds generative art with p5.js using seeded randomness, packaged as one self-contained HTML file you can open in a browser and redraw by changing parameters.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for art made with code, or mention generative art, flow fields, particle systems, etc. It asks for original work, not copies of existing artists, to avoid copyright issues.

say_en.text: Make a generative art piece of a particle flow field with p5.js
say_en.note: Writes a philosophy first, then an interactive HTML

say_en.text: Do a 'Quantum Harmonics' algorithmic art piece with seed 42
say_en.note: Same seed always gives the same output

say_en.text: Increase the particle count in that piece and regenerate
say_en.note: Sliders and seed controls update the canvas
